_note: Learning ledger for whether a video captured attention, produced reflection, encouraged application and preserved autonomy. Comment-derived measures are low-confidence proxies, never psychological diagnoses.

metric_definitions.belief_analysis_yield_proxy: Share of scanned comments tagged reflection, application, curiosity or constructive disagreement.
metric_definitions.autonomy_risk_proxy: Share tagged dependency, certainty transfer, distress or metaphysical/clinical misinterpretation.
metric_definitions.scene_feedback: James's explicit approvals, rejections and reasons; highest-trust craft evidence.
metric_definitions.confidence: low until sufficient comments, retention and repeated contextual tests exist.
